intro.text: An ardent in Urithiru, head scientist for atmospheric measurements.

items.text: In 1175 Brother Benneh excitedly told Navani that temperature and pressure outside Urithiru rise, rather than fall, before highstorms, and confirmed that the Cloudwalk is warmer than the fields below. When Navani suggested that was expected at altitude, he cited measurements from trade expeditions to the Horneater Peaks that showed otherwise.

appearance.text: Bald like other ardents, he has an unusually long neck, and the skin under his chin sags.
